purpose: Use only H7 fresh metadata support, with no H7 image pixels or colour outcomes, to choose a feasible balanced species-by-cell sampling strength for a new H8 experiment.

automatic_design_selection.eligible_designs: matrix cells with qualifying_species >= 35 and minimum_qualifying_cells_per_species >= 5
automatic_design_selection.tie_break: deterministic lexical order of numeric pair (per_cell_threshold, cells)
automatic_design_selection.species_rule: retain every species meeting the selected metadata support rule; do not select using H6/H6b effects or flower colour
automatic_design_selection.target_cell_rule: for each retained species, select exactly five H7 target cells with highest H7 retained fresh metadata count; ties use lower cell_id
automatic_design_selection.h8_measurement_gate: after H8 fresh measurement, a species is evaluable only if all five fixed H8 target cells have at least 10 classifiable photos

claim_ceiling: This audit can choose only a metadata-feasible H8 sampling design. It is not a biological result and cannot rescue H7 or any prior H1-H6 inference.
